notes: Fermi-LAT search for spectral irregularities from photon-ALP oscillations in NGC 1275 (Perseus cluster) using 6 years of Pass 8 data. Excludes g_agamma > 5e-12 GeV^-1 for 0.5-5 neV, and g11 > ~1 (i.e. 1e-11 GeV^-1) for 5-10 neV, at 95% CL. This is an astrophysical propagation bound (magnetic field conversion), not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumption applies. Numerical values taken from explicit text statements; the full exclusion contour (including an unexcluded 'hole'-like feature around Ecrit ~1 GeV with 1.3<g11<4) is only in Fig. 2 and not tabulated, so the emitted points approximate the lower boundary of the excluded region.
